clips.title: The story
paras: Splintertree Post holds the Horde’s eastern Ashenvale frontier, northwest of Felfire Hill. Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan established it during the Third War as a fortified base against the night elves and a staging ground for expansion.

Splintertree Post anchors the Horde’s military and supply lines across eastern Ashenvale. Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan founded it when the orcs first entered the forest during the Third War. Orcish and tauren scouts and warriors still defend the armed outpost. An inn, a flight master, and steady supplies from Orgrimmar support the Horde’s contested hold beneath the trees.

Splintertree Post remains ready for attack. The night elves have neither forgotten nor forgiven Grommash’s actions during the war. They also oppose the Horde’s continued logging and raids on Astranaar. Sentinels hide in the surrounding woods and launch constant retaliatory guerrilla strikes, testing the post’s watchmen at all hours.
